patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 serializes Part.blend_mode as an integral enum but deserializes it as a string, preventing genuine Part-containing puppets produced by inWriteINPPuppet from being reopened for M1 real-artifact inspection.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision can round-trip its own Part.blend_mode output without this compatibility patch.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 JSON deserialization treats nulib nstring as a D string and uses cast(T)data.str, bypassing nstring ownership/copy semantics and leaving metadata/node names backed by transient JSON memory after inLoadPuppet returns.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision deserializes nulib nstring values through an owning constructor/assignment and loaded strings remain valid after JSON parser storage is released.
